name: UFC | svc.detect_card_changes
description: Compares the sheet fight card with the official UFC card (verified against ESPN) and records added, removed, replaced, re-ordered and changed bouts, plus UFC bout id adoptions. Never edits the sheet.

parameters.url: =https://site.api.espn.com/apis/site/v2/sports/mma/ufc/scoreboard?dates={{ DateTime.fromISO($('Prepare UFC Card Request').first().json.event_datetime_local).minus({days:1}).toFormat('yyyyLLdd') }}-{{ DateTime.fromISO($('Prepare UFC Card Request').first().json.event_datetime_local).plus({days:1}).toFormat('yyyyLLdd') }}

nodeGroups.name: Load the saved card
nodeGroups.description: Read the saved card state and the Fight Card, and decide whether the card can be checked (not locked, has an official URL).

nodeGroups.name: Check against UFC and ESPN
nodeGroups.description: Fetch the official UFC card and ESPN data, describe every difference from the sheet, and record it in the card state.
